proposal.reason: Main change is open-source test orchestration: dual-platform (M890P/810E) PR/daily workflow execution, case generation/grouping/reconciliation, hardware allocation/rack policy handling, HPN SDK install selection/propagation, and executor runtime/device-mapping diagnostics. Renamed workflow files, new platform profiles, and large added 810E test-family manifests are all CI dataset/execution plumbing rather than review-policy or product-runtime module changes.
